title: Humans Shaped Amazon Rainforest Ecosystems
reason: The video describes the theory that the Amazon rainforest is partially man-made and the concept of terra preta.

tasks.task: Describe the theory that the Amazon rainforest is at least partially man-made.

subtasks.text: Observe the preponderance of trees that serve human needs in the Amazon rainforest.
Note the dominance of trees like Brazil nut trees that provide food for human beings.

tasks.task: Explain the concept of terra preta.

subtasks.text: Highlight the man-made, nutrient-dense soil that allows for incredible agriculture.
Mention that the method of creating terra preta remains a mystery to this day.
